# gof-design-patterns

Orchestrates Gang of Four design pattern implementations across 8 languages. Analyses user problems to select optimal pattern(s) from creational, structural, and behavioural categories. Provides concrete, production-ready implementations with explanations and trade-offs.

- **Entry point:** [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)
- **Version:** 2.0
- **Licence:** Apache-2.0, see [LICENSE](LICENSE)

## Install

Copy this directory into either skills location, then start a new session:

```bash
cp -r gof-design-patterns ~/.claude/skills/       # personal, all projects
cp -r gof-design-patterns .claude/skills/         # this project only
```

For Claude Desktop, zip the directory and upload it under
Settings, Capabilities, Skills. Released builds attach a ready-made zip.

## Bundled files

Loaded on demand, not up front. SKILL.md routes to them.

- `resources/behavioral-patterns.md`
- `resources/creational-patterns.md`
- `resources/language-guide.md`
- `resources/pattern-selection-guide.md`
- `resources/patterns-reference.md`
- `resources/structural-patterns.md`

## Part of a larger set

One of the Engineering practices skills (`claude-skills-engineering-practices`). See the [group's list](../../README.md),
or every group in [claude-skills](https://github.com/markpitt/claude-skills).
